name: client.health
description: Advisory. Judge ONE client-health read for a RIG client: is there named evidence of contact and a real signal about whether the client is fine, drifting, or at risk. Never grants an outward action.

risk_call.instructions: What is the actual health verdict for this client

criteria.stable: Contact plus a delivered outcome inside the window
criteria.drifting: Delivered work but contact has thinned or a request has aged
criteria.at_risk: No contact in the window, or an unresolved complaint or missed deliverable
criteria.unknown: Not enough evidence to call it

evidence_named.instructions: The read names the artifact it measured: a file path, a ledger key, a dated message, or a ticket

no_invented_number.instructions: No figure in the read is invented; every count traces to a source or is marked UNKNOWN

action_proposed.instructions: A next action is proposed for anything not called stable

rules.reason: no evidence to call health; report as unknown, not as fine
health read without named evidence is a vibe
at-risk client: a human decides the outreach, the agent drafts
